limitations: The original problem remains PARTIAL: no structural representation-theoretic description in higher irreducible rank is supplied.
The uniform construction is generic terminating computability via rational Lie input and semialgebraic topology, not a practical triangulation implementation.
No higher-rank instance of the general triangulation search has been executed.
No closed root-combinatorial differential, canonical or minimal model, or higher-rank extension formula is claimed.
The full explicit closed family is A1^r, with arbitrary central torus factors and central isogenies.
All fields are allowed, including characteristics dividing the Weyl-group order; no averaging or modular semisimplicity is used.
The action is the free right normalizer Weyl action for connected complex reductive groups, not a substitution of the holomorphic left action on G/B.
Garnier v5 has arXiv version date 2026-06-30 and manuscript front-page date 2026-07-01. Its explicit SL3 example and the earlier Chirivi–Garnier–Spreafico example concern real flags.
Delfs–Knebusch was not inspected theorem by theorem; termination is supported independently by Basu and the audit algebraic-parameter reduction.
No novelty, priority, exhaustive literature survey, or present global-open-status certificate is claimed.
